property_type: Residential built property (mixed builder floors/apartments/independent houses) secondary market — NOT a verified raw vacant-plot rate

price_per_sqyd_range.note: Interpolated: average of Sector 43 (Rs.15,550/sqft) and Sector 45 (Rs.16,100/sqft) listing rates from Square Yards, converted at 9 sqft/sqyd. NOT a direct measurement for Sector 44 itself — no direct listing-price figure for Sector 44 was found.

infra_notes: Sector 44 sits in central/old Gurugram, directly between Sector 43 and Sector 45, near the Golf Course Road / DLF corridor and MG Road — an established, mature locality (not a new-launch peripheral sector), which is why it is priced closer to DLF/Golf Course Road micro-markets than to newer sectors like New Gurgaon or Dwarka Expressway in Gurugram-wide PropIndex data (see gurugram_city_overview.json).
source_name: Estimated from Square Yards locality listing pages for adjacent Sector 43 and Sector 45 (accessed via web search) — no direct Sector 44 figure or official government circle rate was retrievable this pass. An official Haryana Collector Rate PDF for Gurugram Tehsil (2024-2025, effective 01.12.2024) exists at gurugram.gov.in/collectorrates/ but is a scanned image PDF with no extractable text layer — its exact Sector 44 rate is NOT yet captured here and would need OCR or manual lookup to add.
